# oss-pce-cd-bios

> Open-source PC Engine / TurboGrafx-CD Super System Card 3.0 BIOS replacement project. Development-only firmware, not a commercially compatible BIOS or a distributable replacement release.

Project home (English): https://mao2009.github.io/oss-pce-cd-bios/
Project home (Japanese): https://mao2009.github.io/oss-pce-cd-bios/ja/
Source repository: https://github.com/mao2009/oss-pce-cd-bios

## Evidence-scoped progress (2026-10-22 main 86172e2)

- Main commit: https://github.com/mao2009/oss-pce-cd-bios/commit/86172e2c8a65f1759b83c6b61b5a42b6bc2af295
- The 256 KiB DEV-only ROM provides 81 candidate System Card entry slots.
- Eight slots ($1E EX_GETVER, $3C EX_BINBCD, $3D EX_BCDBIN, $3F MA_MUL8U, $40 MA_MUL8S, $41 MA_MUL16U, $42 MA_DIV16S, $43 MA_DIV16U) hold project-owned DEV implementations; none is owner-approved or reference-ABI-verified. 73 other slots are nonreturning stubs.
- Separate metrics: DEV implemented = 8/81; owner-approved DEV_CALLABLE = 0; reference ABI VERIFIED = 0/81; reference JSR execution permission = 0/81; all slot readiness states NOT_READY; release_eligible = false.
- PR #480 merged MA_DIV16U ($43) with project-defined unsigned-division checks and pinned Geargrafx real-core tests, not reference BIOS equivalence.
- PR #481 merged a SYNTHETIC caller-stack contract experiment: an I/O-mapped stack (MPR1=$FF) changes VDC register values during the JSR/guard pushes before any refusal. This is not a production safety guard. #473, #459 and #367 remain unresolved/BLOCKED.
- PR #475 (EX_GETVER synthetic observation schema) and PR #477 (local ROM 81-slot static profile) are Draft, not merged to main. Only seven earlier reference API static records are tracked on main. Local CRC32 matching does not authenticate the headered private reference ROM; SHA-256 identity is unresolved (#476).
- Pinned Geargrafx tests also observe EX_GETVER DEV return, synthetic SCSI READ(6) into RAM and isolated CD-to-RAM payload execution. None proves BIOS-mediated disc boot, callable CD_RESET/CD_BASE/CD_READ, or retail compatibility.
- No retail game boot has been demonstrated. A lawful local PC Engine CD copy of Shin Megami Tensei is a planned boot-path/blocking-API test, strictly subject to existing safety gates.
- Reference ABI remains UNVERIFIED; reference ROM execution is BLOCKED and firmware release is blocked. The dated 2026-10-20 and 2026-10-21 counts are historical, not the current main count.
- 2026-10-20 safety/evidence foundations: #349, #359, #360, #362, #371 and #374 improved validation, test and publication controls within limited scopes.

## Boundaries

This is a dated community information page, not a download link or an executable compatibility certificate. ROM fingerprints, local static analyses, synthetic tests, code review and CI signatures are distinct evidence levels; do not infer ABI VERIFIED, commercial compatibility, licensing rights to proprietary ROMs or physical-hardware behavior. Source/ROM/media distribution and reuse must follow the repository provenance policy.
